name: ton-jetton-htlc
description: Hashed-timelock contract for TON jettons, matching Freicoin's OP_SHA256 script — the TON half of a cross-chain atomic swap

scripts.test: node test/lock.mjs && node test/jetton.mjs && node test/pok-layout.mjs
scripts.page: node web/src/gen-code.mjs && esbuild web/src/lock.mjs --bundle --minify --format=iife --outfile=web/dist/lock.js && esbuild web/src/swap-page.mjs --bundle --minify --format=iife --outfile=web/dist/swap.js
